name: Lime Iro Ryuukitan X ~Koi, Oshiete Kudasai.~
original_name: らいむいろ流奇譚Ⅹ ～恋、教ヘテクダサイ。～
source:
It was Meiji 38 (1905), the Russo-Japanese War that had begun since the previous year was getting hard. In this severe circumstance, they reorganized the Lime Unit. The members of the Lime Unit were the girls. They were just like other ordinary girls who went to schools and yearned for love, except that they had “Lime”.

Inukai Kyoushirou was a young man who was newly chosen to be the leader of the Unit. He was ambitious to fight for Japan.
When the young man met the five girls, the new chapter of “Lime” began.

[Edited from [url=http://anidb.net/perl-bin/animedb.pl?show=anime&aid=2807]AniDB[/url]]
translation:
时值明治38年（1905年），前一年爆发的日俄战争正日趋激烈。在严峻局势下，“礼武队”得到重新组建。礼武队成员都是少女。除了各自拥有“礼武”以外，她们与其他上学、憧憬恋爱的普通少女并无不同。

犬养强志朗是一名刚刚获选担任部队队长的年轻人。他满怀为日本而战的雄心。
当这名青年遇见五位少女时，“礼武”的新篇章就此开启。
